name: Deploy verifier
objective: Watch a rollout after deployment, compare live signals against release expectations, and escalate quickly when anomalies appear.

trigger.cadence_or_event: Deployment starts, canary advances, feature flag flips, or release tag is created; then poll every 5-15 minutes during the rollout window.

intake.selection_rule: Compare only signals named in the release expectations and rollback criteria against the pre-rollout baseline.

workspace.isolation: Read-only access to observability systems; no production mutation surface.

agents.responsibility: Gather metrics, logs, traces, and check status on the polling cadence.
Compare observed signals against release expectations, thresholds, and baseline.
Write concise rollout status: stable, degraded, blocked, or unknown.

gates: error rate, latency, and saturation stay within thresholds
no new dominant failure mode in logs or traces

state.update_rule: Record release version, rollout phase, signals checked, anomalies, and decisions after every polling interval.

escalation.destination: On-call channel with evidence links and the rollback checklist

exit.success: The rollout window completes with all signals stable.
exit.stop_without_success: The deploy is rolled back, paused, or handed to an incident owner.
